audience: original internal MapRank delivery and derived operator guide

sources.title: Current application pricing
sources.finding: Monthly USD: Solo19/4,900credits/9x9/one seat; Agency39/12,250/11x11/unlimited seats; Pro79/29,400/21x21; Scale149/58,800/21x21. Pro and Scale include custom domains; lower plans use branded MapRank links. All include scheduled weekly/biweekly/monthly scans, comparisons, API and unlimited businesses/keywords. Annual rates display20% reduction. Pricing expresses a standard scan as49points and quotes exact costs before execution. Older accounts retain their plan. Pricing text conflicts about when plan changes apply: next invoice versus immediately; use actual account checkout for a change.

sources.title: Terms of Service
sources.finding: One free manual5x5 demo for one business; a failed demo can be retried. Further, scheduled, API or MCP scans require a paid plan. One credit per grid point; app displays cost. Rankings sample public results at scan time, without a future outcome guarantee. Cancellation preserves business/history; unused monthly credits expire when inactive. Top-ups remain a separate balance and require an active plan for scanning. Paid fees generally nonrefundable. Share links readable by anyone holding the link. Current terms corroborate Pro custom domains and21x21 Pro/Scale.

sources.title: Privacy Policy
sources.finding: Stores business name/address/coordinates/PlaceID, category, keywords, logo, grid and schedule; scan includes points, found/rank and scoring responses. Google Places finds businesses; DataForSEO provides Maps results; Mapbox draws maps. Invitations retain email/role/project scope. Shared reports/public rank maps are public by possession of URL. API full key is shown once; only hash/prefix/usage/revocation data retained. Account data remains while open; closure/deletion request removes within90days, including backup aging. Deletion is staff-assisted via support@maprank.so. US Supabase region is us-east-2. Same-login sibling products have distinct scope.

sources.title: Published MCP and REST workflow
sources.finding: Five tools: get_account, list_businesses, run_scan, get_scan, list_scans. REST GET/api/v1/account, GET/api/v1/businesses, POST/api/v1/scans, GET/api/v1/scans, GET/api/v1/scans/:id; bearer key; asynchronous scan IDs. Connector reads/runs existing businesses. Add-business, branding and share-link actions remain in app. Results include average rank, best rank, top3coverage and point data. No search volume, keyword difficulty, citation-building, review-management or site audits. Exact request/response field names, pagination, rate limits and average-rank missing conventions are not specified by this public page. Its domain/tier claims conflict with current app pricing.

sources.title: Grid method guide
sources.finding: Recommends category phrases, market-appropriate spacing, identical coordinates for repeat comparisons and multiple observations rather than interpreting one point as a verdict. Its500freecredits/4,500Soloallowance/13x13limits are superseded by current pricing/terms.

sources.title: Rank checker definitions
sources.finding: Defines top3coverage as proportion of gridpoints in ranks1–3; reports averageposition; describes not-found as absent from top20. Marketing sample is explicitly sample data. It does not specify average calculation for absent or errored points. Its7x7/one-mile coverage description says12-mile square, while apppricing describes roughly6miles; exact received coordinates determine comparison geometry.

sources.title: Profile tracking workflow
sources.finding: Each location is its own business/grid/defaults. By-name public results tracking needs no GBP manager access, does not alter the profile and is distinct from organic website ranking. Describes baseline, change record and same-grid repeat.

sources.title: Marketing homepage
sources.finding: Still states own-domain reports on all plans and Pro/Scale13x13. Treat those fields as stale against current app pricing and October11terms. Its illustrated coffee-shop ranks are marked as a sample, and provide no agency/client baseline.

sources.title: Actual signup
sources.finding: Actual onboarding sequence: create account, add client, first scan. Email/password or Google sign-in; current free offer is one5x5demo. No account was created during this read-only source task.
